Medir em microgravidade a concentração m: Measure in microgravity the minimum O₂ concentration that sustains flame spread (MLOC) and verify a method that predicts it from ground tests, as the basis of an international standard.
LOC (em 1g): menor O₂ com propagação des: LOC (in 1g): lowest O₂ with steady downward spread. MLOC: the minimum of the limiting curve in microgravity as the opposed flow is varied; Vcr is the velocity at which that minimum occurs.
Com fluxo oposto lento a chama se exting: With slow opposed flow the flame is extinguished by radiative loss; with fast flow, by blowoff. Between the two there is an O₂ minimum (the limiting curve is "U"-shaped).
Abaixo da curva-limite a chama não se su: Below the limiting curve the flame is not sustained; above it, spread continues.
